YOU CAN EDIT THE SPRITES AND USE THEM IN NON COMMERCIAL PROJECTS

YOU CAN'T EDIT THE SPRITES AND USE THEM IN COMMERCIAL PROJECTS

can: YOU CAN USE THE ASSET IN NON COMMERCIAL PROJECTS
YOU CAN EDIT THE SPRITES AND USE THEM IN NON COMMERCIAL PROJECTS

notes: Permits non-commercial use and editing for non-commercial projects (fits STACK 2026 academic/student prototype).
Strictly prohibits commercial use, commercial derivative edits, and reselling.
Does not specify an author name or attribution format; verify original pack page (appears to be LimeZu Modern Interiors Free) before public release.
Does NOT cover Gather Town reference screenshots (1.png through 7.png), which are third-party product screenshots.

free_pack_non_commercial.summary: Non-commercial use and non-commercial sprite editing permitted; commercial use, commercial editing, and reselling prohibited. No explicit attribution string or author name is included in LICENSE.txt.

third_party_ui_reference_unlicensed.summary: Third-party Gather Town UI screenshots retained strictly as design reference. Not covered by assets/LICENSE.txt; must never be redistributed or used as game assets.

unverified_legacy_provenance.summary: Stored alongside LICENSE.txt under assets/Old/ and likely an earlier version of the same free pack, but lacks a folder-level license confirmation.

unresolved_classification_questions.question: Characters_free named sheets (Adam, Alex, Amelia, Bob) exist only at 16x16 native scale (16x32 / 32x32 frames), while Interiors_free and Room_Builder_free provide 16x16, 32x32, and 48x48 (pixel-exact 1x, 2x, 3x upscales) and Characters_MV.png is 48x96. Should LearnNexus standardize Phaser runtime assets on 16x16 with integer 3x camera zoom (matching all 7 character animations), or 48x48 with 1x zoom (requiring 3x nearest-neighbor upscale of Characters_free)?

unresolved_classification_questions.topic: Exact attribution and author metadata for LICENSE.txt
unresolved_classification_questions.question: assets/LICENSE.txt allows non-commercial use and editing but omits author name, pack URL, and attribution wording. Confirm original pack provenance (appears to be LimeZu 'Modern Interiors Free') and whether attribution credits should be added to README/about screen.

assets/Old/ contains 24 older tileset and character files (Tileset_*_1/2/3/9/16 and Character 2 in 16/32/48 resolutions) whose styles overlap with Room_Builder_free. Should Old/ assets remain archived or be imported into Phaser tilesets?

unresolved_classification_questions.topic: Ambiguous touching and multi-part sprites in Interiors_free
unresolved_classification_questions.question: Interiors_free contains touching furniture groups (e.g., wide modular counter/sofa/bookshelf blocks spanning up to 15x5 tiles) and tiny disconnected decorative pieces (7 components <= 4px side in 16x16). Review the ambiguous contact sheet to decide which blobs should be split into individual furniture items and which tiny pieces belong to adjacent objects.

unresolved_classification_questions.topic: Semantic naming of extracted Interiors_free props
unresolved_classification_questions.question: Interiors_free contains ~269 connected components spanning desks, chairs, sofas, rugs, beds, kitchen/study props, cabinets, plants, windows, doors, and decor. Review contact sheets to assign final semantic IDs and mark which objects are interactive workstations vs static decor.

Component 100 in Interiors_free (y=1584..1665 in 48x48; y=528..555 in 16x16) contains semi-transparent alpha values (161, 220, 242). Confirm whether these should be kept as translucent overlays in Phaser.
